scope: Exact additions from docs/aave_sofa_support.md section 2 only. No full-ABI admission. Runtime consumes catalog.json, not this evidence.
limitations: Supplied calldata inventory binds chain, exact target and selector; calldata was not executed.
Sourcify proxy resolution/match grades are inventory evidence, not a fresh runtime identity attestation.
Failed ABI retrieval and interface-only fallback limitations are retained explicitly.
ERC-20 return data is not decoded by authorization; where no individual declaration was available, standard bool output follows the existing catalog convention.
Merkl reward distributor is a separate protocol used by the Aave workflow.
No API-key grant, profile, pause, nested-execution policy or signing permission is changed.
